record.paper_title: String Theory on ADS3: Some Open Questions
record.original_question: For string theories on higher-dimensional anti-de Sitter spaces AdSn, how can exact conformal sigma models or conformal field theories be constructed and analyzed, including their spectra and interactions, when odd-dimensional cases require additional antisymmetric-tensor and linear-dilaton backgrounds and even-dimensional exact conformal field theories have not been investigated?

evidence.quote: string theories on more general ADSn backgrounds are equally important and more difficult than the three-dimensional case at hand.

In odd dimensions, it has been realized very recently that both an antisymmetric tensor and a linear dilaton are needed together with the gravitational background, in order to define an exactly conformal sigma model describing the string.
This sigma model is not a WZW model, and its spectrum and interactions remain quite unexplored.
the exact conformal field theories describing the string propagation on even-dimensional anti-de Sitter spaces have never been investigated.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider bosonic string propagation on an anti-de Sitter background AdS_n of arbitrary dimension n ≥ 3 (with Lorentzian signature and constant negative curvature). The worldsheet theory must be an exact conformal field theory (CFT) — i.e., a two-dimensional sigma model with vanishing beta functions to all orders in the α' expansion — whose target space is (or admits as a factor) AdS_n, together with the additional background fields required for exact conformal invariance:

(i) For odd n, exact conformal invariance is known to require a nontrivial Neveu–Schwarz antisymmetric tensor (B-field) background and a linear dilaton in addition to the AdS_n metric; the resulting sigma model is not a Wess–Zumino–Witten model on a group manifold.

(ii) For even n, no exact CFT describing string propagation on AdS_n has been formulated.

The problem is to:

(a) Construct, for each n ≥ 4, an exact conformal sigma model (i.e., specify the metric, B-field, dilaton, and possibly other background fields, together with the worldsheet action and its quantization) whose target geometry contains AdS_n as the spacetime factor, and prove its exact conformal invariance.

(b) Determine the full physical spectrum of the resulting worldsheet CFT, including all primary states, their conformal weights, the action of the spacetime isometry algebra so(n−1,2), and the unitarity constraints.

(c) Compute the interactions: define vertex operators for the physical states and determine their correlation functions (at least the tree-level two-, three-, and four-point functions on the sphere), including the analogue of spectral flow if relevant, and analyze factorization and the operator product expansion.

Provide a complete solution in both the odd-dimensional case (where the antisymmetric tensor and linear dilaton enter) and the even-dimensional case (where no such construction is yet available).
artifact.status_search_result: No complete construction of exact worldsheet CFTs for string theory on AdS_n with n ≥ 4 appears in the literature. Partial results exist for coset-based exact metric/dilaton/antisymmetric-tensor backgrounds (e.g., SO(d−1,2)/SO(d−1,1) gauged WZNW models) giving the conformally exact geometry, but the full spectrum and interactions of the corresponding non-WZW sigma models remain largely unexplored, and even-dimensional AdS_n exact CFTs have not been formulated. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Conformally exact metric and dilaton in string theory on curved spacetime
status_evidence.snippet: Applied to SO(d-1,2)_{-k}/SO(d-1,1)_{-k} coset models relevant for string theory on curved spacetime; explicit conformally exact metric and dilaton given for d=2,3,4.
status_evidence.claim: Only conformally exact background fields are constructed; the full spectrum and interactions of the resulting sigma models in higher-dimensional AdS are not derived.

status_evidence.title: Two-dimensional conformal sigma models and exact string solutions
status_evidence.snippet: General framework for constructing exact conformal sigma models from G/H cosets with nontrivial dilaton and antisymmetric tensor.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a framework but does not yield a complete worldsheet CFT for AdS_n with computed spectrum and interactions.

status_evidence.title: Exact approaches on the string worldsheet
status_evidence.snippet: Recent review of exact worldsheet methods; exact CFTs for AdS_n with n>3 still not fully developed.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-dimensional AdS exact worldsheet CFTs remain an active and unresolved area.
